# Trusta Sustain Corporation

Trusta Sustain Corporation is a U.S.-based AI, engineering, technical-services, products, and applied R&D company founded in 2023.

## Core capabilities
Artificial intelligence, workflow automation, data analytics, CRM and revenue automation, RFP and proposal analysis, engineering consulting, data-center cooling and energy optimization, water and wastewater, environmental engineering, EHS, sustainability, infrastructure, technical assessments, and applied R&D.
